request.lint_command: ruff check --ignore SIM114,C400,BLE001,UP012,SIM102,F841,PLW1510,RUF059,SIM117 mncs_env/doctor.py mncs_env/capability_intelligence.py tests/test_doctor.py tests/test_capability_intelligence.py

verified_properties: Store-backed Doctor epoch recording retains the exact immutable artifact reference on its matching bounded history row while preserving the current top-level reference.
Default history projection performs no additional Doctor artifact reads; --doctor-gap-limit enables the strict, demand-driven path.
Historical recurrence counts only distinct records whose content identity, session identity, epoch digest, timestamp, and summary match the history row.
Legacy rows without per-pass references remain unavailable, and response-budget compaction retains recurrence status and provenance references.
Historical analysis is limited to eight recent entries and 512 gap rows per artifact; omissions and incomplete coverage remain explicit.
outcome.interpretation_limit: Regression fixtures establish bounds, provenance checks, and partial-history handling. The separate live readback establishes one authentic post-change Doctor pass; this verification does not establish independent agent receipt or burden reduction.

related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence and Continuous Improvement Campaign

measurement_limits: The full repository suite was not run for this bounded change.
Ruff verification excluded the listed pre-existing repository findings; the changed lines introduced no remaining Ruff finding.
Passing tests do not establish independent agent discovery, service fulfillment for unrecorded needs, or reduced agent intervention.
